Summary of Changes


src/routes/accounts.ts:

Imported withErrors from ../framework/errors.ts.
Wrapped the async GET handler router.get('/accounts/:id', withErrors(async (req, res) => ...)) with withErrors.
Wrapped the named async POST handler router.post('/accounts', withErrors(async function createAccount(req, res) ...)) with withErrors.
Left synchronous route GET /health, documentation, and unrelatedHelper untouched.



src/routes/orders.ts:

Imported withErrors from ../framework/errors.ts.
Wrapped the async GET handler router.get('/orders/:id', withErrors(async (req, res) => ...)) with withErrors.
Wrapped the async DELETE handler router.delete('/orders/:id', withErrors(async (req, res) => ...)) with withErrors.
Left the inner array callback [req.id].map(async ...) and audit.get(...) untouched.



tests/regression.test.mjs:

Added regression test suite verifying:

Preservation of route registration order and methods.
Successful request handling and response values for GET /accounts/:id, POST /accounts, GET /orders/:id, and DELETE /orders/:id.
Error forwarding to next for each registered async route when failures occur.
Preservation of synchronous execution for GET /health without wrapping.
Confirmation that helper functions and unrelated audit callbacks remain unwrapped.

lines.text: export interface RequestContext { readonly requestId: string; readonly userId: string; }
export function createContext(value: string, userId: string): RequestContext {return {requestId:value,userId};}
export function forkContext(context: RequestContext, suffix: string): RequestContext {return {...context, requestId: context.requestId+'/'+suffix};}
export function describeJob(job: Job, context: RequestContext) {return {requestId:job.requestId,trace:context.requestId,audit:auditLabel(job.requestId),name:job.name};}
export function response(context: ActiveContext, payload: unknown) {return {requestId:context.requestId,payload};}
export function work(context: RequestContext, job: Job) {const child=forkContext(context,'worker');return describeJob(job,child);}

export function handle(trace: string,user: string,job: Job) {const context=createContext(trace,user);return {context,headers:headers(context),logs:logFields(context),body:response(context,work(context,job))};}

lines.text: export interface RequestContext { readonly requestId: string; readonly userId: string; }
export function createContext(value: string, userId: string): RequestContext {return {requestId:value,userId};}
export function forkContext(context: RequestContext, suffix: string): RequestContext {return {...context, requestId: context.requestId+'/'+suffix};}
export interface Job {requestId: string; name: string;}
export function describeJob(job: Job, context: RequestContext) {return {requestId:job.requestId,trace:context.requestId,audit:auditLabel(job.requestId),name:job.name};}
export function response(context: ActiveContext, payload: unknown) {return {requestId:context.requestId,payload};}
export function work(context: RequestContext, job: Job) {const child=forkContext(context,'worker');return describeJob(job,child);}

export function handle(trace: string,user: string,job: Job) {const context=createContext(trace,user);return {context,headers:headers(context),logs:logFields(context),body:response(context,work(context,job))};}

Renamed RequestContext.requestId to traceId:

src/context.ts: Updated RequestContext interface definition so requestId is renamed to traceId (without retaining any compatibility requestId member).
src/context-factory.ts: Updated createContext to instantiate {traceId: value, userId} and forkContext to propagate {...context, traceId: context.traceId+'/'+suffix} while maintaining non-mutation of the original context.
src/logging.ts: Updated context destructuring to extract traceId (const {traceId, userId} = context;) while preserving the wire/output key requestId (return {requestId: traceId, userId};).
src/middleware.ts: Updated headers to read context.traceId for the 'x-request-id' header value.
src/jobs.ts: Updated describeJob to assign trace: context.traceId while keeping job.requestId, auditLabel(job.requestId), and the output key requestId: job.requestId unchanged.

src/plugins/plugin0.ts through src/plugins/plugin7.ts: Updated all 8 plugins to read context.traceId while preserving their output keys (requestId: context.traceId).
src/plugins/index.ts: Preserved traceSummary and its plugin callers intact.
src/catalog/*: Kept all independent RequestContext definitions and requestId properties intact.

Renamed RequestContext.requestId to traceId:

src/context.ts: Updated RequestContext interface definition so requestId was replaced with readonly traceId: string. No backward-compatibility member was retained.
src/context-factory.ts: Updated createContext to initialize {traceId: value, userId} and forkContext to propagate {...context, traceId: context.traceId + '/' + suffix} without mutating the parent context.
src/logging.ts: Updated destructuring from context to {traceId, userId} while preserving the existing output key requestId: traceId.
src/middleware.ts: Updated headers to read context.traceId for the 'x-request-id' header.
src/jobs.ts: Updated describeJob to map trace: context.traceId while keeping job.requestId and auditLabel(job.requestId) unchanged.

Absence of requestId and presence of traceId on RequestContext.
